compiler: pinned GCC 13.3.0, O3, static, PGO off on all four sides
interpretation: I06 remains default-off: update+64 mixed exact/ANN queries does not show consistent gains; second ANN access rebuilds and consumes the first exact-query rebuild saving.
The first post-update exact request is faster for 1/10 updates, but this is not an entire-workload win; 100 distinct updates exceed the delta cap of 64.

I07 is a strong isolated screening candidate for 8KiB-payload spilled tables: both selective and all-hit scalar filters avoid row materialization. Requires repeated PGO whole-request confirmation before default adoption.
Combined default/unfiltered spill cases are broadly neutral or slightly worse; the unfiltered spill scenario does not exercise scalar-cache filtering.
Each scenario has only 3 pairs; ratios are baseline/candidate, values above 1 favor candidate. No official score conversion.
Sampled /proc rchar/syscr count process read traffic/syscalls, not physical storage traffic. Warm query device read_bytes are generally zero; RSS/HWM are process proxies.
Initial context.json contains an older correctness-only limitation string; performance-summary.json and all three raw paired reports establish the later measured screening scope.
